steps.eval: (() => { window.__q967 = []; const get = () => { const me = [...document.querySelectorAll('.anc:not(.foe)')].find(e => (e.querySelector('.anc-plate')?.textContent || '').includes('你')); const nums = (me?.querySelector('.anc-nums')?.textContent || '').trim(); const ap = (document.body.innerText.match(/你 · 普通激活 · AP (\d)\/\d/) || [])[1] || ''; return nums + '|' + ap + '|' + !!document.querySelector('.bfx-layer'); }; let last = ''; let i = 0; const tick = () => { const s = get(); if (s !== last) { window.__q967.push(s); last = s; } if (++i < 200) setTimeout(tick, 20); }; tick(); setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.anc.foe.targetable').click(), 60); return true; })()
steps.label: 开始记录并出手
记录（体|AP|特写中）

steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__q967.map(s => s.split('|')); const i = L.findIndex(x => x[2] === 'true' && x[1] === '3'); const j = L.findIndex(x => x[1] === '1'); return i >= 0 && j === i + 1 && L[j][2] === 'true' && L[j][0] !== L[i][0]; })()
steps.label: Q967 特写开始体力为出手前值，结果帧体力与 AP 同时变

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const btn = t => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.offsetParent && b.textContent.includes(t)); for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { await w(800); if (!document.querySelector('.anc')) return true; if (document.querySelector('.bfx-layer')) continue; const ap = document.body.innerText.match(/你 · \S+ · AP (\d)\/\d/); if (!ap) continue; if (+ap[1] >= 2) { if (!document.querySelector('.anc.foe.targetable')) { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('span,b,div')].find(e => e.offsetParent && e.textContent.trim() === '斩击'); s && s.click(); await w(300); } document.querySelector('.anc.foe.targetable')?.click(); } else { btn('结束行动')?.click(); await w(300); btn('确认结束行动')?.click(); } } return false; })()
steps.label: 打完这场

steps.note: Q969 建材拖到营地地点卡的提示；Q970 显示全部进顶栏全部配方（不含设施配方）

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const src = document.querySelector('[data-pt=shelf-ground] [data-pt=card-wood]'); src.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); await w(200); const tgt = document.querySelector('.map-card'); const c = e => { const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.x + b.width / 2, b.y + b.height / 2]; }; const [x0, y0] = c(src); const [x1, y1] = c(tgt); const ev = (t, x, y, el) => (el || document.elementFromPoint(x, y)).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, button: 0, buttons: t === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1, pointerId: 1, isPrimary: true, pointerType: 'mouse' })); ev('pointerdown', x0, y0, src); await w(50); ev('pointermove', x0 + 20, y0 - 20); await w(400); for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) { ev('pointermove', x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 5, y0 + (y1 - y0) * i / 5); await w(120); } await w(500); ev('pointermove', x1 + 2, y1 + 2); await w(300); const label = document.querySelector('.dg-label')?.textContent; ev('pointerup', x1 + 2, y1 + 2); await w(800); return label; })()
